ai.objective: Cooperate to keep the village alive: grow and deposit food, eat, gather and deposit wood, repair gates, and guard against monsters. Ignoring these jobs can destroy the village. Use past failure lessons.

social_messages.threat: {other}, enemies are at the {gate}. Keep food and repairs coming!
social_messages.low_food: {other}, food is running low. We need harvests in the storehouse.
social_messages.low_wood: {other}, we need more shared wood before the next attack.
social_messages.carrying_food: {other}, I'm carrying {supplies} food. I'll share it at the storehouse.
social_messages.elder_lessons: {other}, share the work and remember why earlier villages fell.
social_messages.generic: {other}, let us keep the village supplied and safe.

roles.farmer: {other}, I'll keep the crops going. Please keep the village supplied.
roles.worker: {other}, I'm checking our wood and repairs. Let's stay prepared.
roles.soldier: {other}, I'm watching the gates. Call if you see trouble.
roles.elder: {other}, everyone's work matters. Keep food and defenses ready.
